description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Flat' which extends an Opencart system controller. It is part of the Admin Controller Extension for Shipping and seems to handle the backend logic for managing a flat rate shipping method in an OpenCart avatar, including displaying the configuration form and saving settings.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: Controller class for managing flat rate shipping options in OpenCart's admin area, including displaying the configuration page and handling save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping flat rate configuration page, preparing data such as breadcrumbs, current settings, and other necessary view data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST request to save the shipping flat rate configuration settings, with permission check and JSON response.
